message:
With storm season upon us, I’ve been thinking back to my childhood when we used to huddle together with flashlights and board games during those wild weather nights. It’s funny how those old-school activities can bring everyone together, even when the weather outside is a bit too lively. I found a handy resource that reminds us of some practical steps to take when preparing for storms, but I also love the idea of rediscovering low-tech fun with family. 

What’s your favorite way to pass the time when the skies get a little too dramatic? 🎲
